description: Hints in a window of the application: the Enter that opens the link a hint pick has focused, and the labels over the targets of a mail tab.

functions.name: sendEnter
functions.description: Sends a trusted Enter key press to the focused element of the window, a main window or a message window. A script click on a link skips Thunderbird's check for a link that lies about its address, and a real key press runs it. The key is fixed and the call takes no text.

functions.name: pick
functions.description: Labels the buttons, tabs, folder rows and message rows on screen in the front mail tab of the window, each in its own document, and takes the keys until a label is typed in full or the labels end. A pick selects a row or clicks a button, and the call itself returns at once with how many labels it drew. With none it starts nothing. The call takes colors and no text to run.

action.description: What a typed label does: focus the target, click it, or copy its address or text. The text to copy is read from the page by the add-on (in the page's own process for a web page), never passed in.

colors.description: The label box and letter colors as #rrggbb for each color scheme. The parent uses the scheme Thunderbird itself shows.
